name: OPTIONSAHOY__AMT_ISO_OPTIMIZE
description: Returns a multi-year Incentive Stock Option (ISO) exercise schedule, searched over its full discretized candidate space to maximize after-tax Net Final Value (NFV) at the planning horizon, minimizing federal and state Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) across the years. Models AMT credit recovery in later years, qualifying-disposition timing, the 10-year grant expiration, and the post-termination exercise window. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Deterministic: same inputs always return the same schedule. Use this for ISO planning; for non-qualified stock options (NSO) use OPTIONSAHOY__NSO_CALCULATE, for restricted stock units (RSU) use OPTIONSAHOY__RSU_SELL_VS_HOLD. Every field listed as required must come from the user or be derivable from an optional ticker; never invent a value.

shares.description: Total ISO shares to exercise across the horizon.

fmv.description: Current fair market value per share, USD (year 1). Future years compound from here using expectedGrowth and volatility.

expectedGrowth.description: Annual expected stock growth as a decimal (0.10 = 10%/year). Required unless ticker resolves it from trailing CAGR.

ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol (e.g. "NVDA"). When set, substitutes a cached trailing return for any unsupplied expected-return field and a cached implied vol for any unsupplied volatility. Unknown tickers fall through to required-field errors.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma) as a decimal (0.5 = 50%). Either this or volatilityDrag is required; if both supplied, volatilityDrag wins. The tool computes horizon-cumulative drag internally; do not compute drag yourself.

volatilityDrag.description: Multiplicative price haircut at the planning horizon. Either this or volatility is required; if both supplied, this wins.

filingStatus.description: United States federal filing status. Drives the ordinary brackets, AMT exemption tier, and AMT exemption phaseout start.

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual W-2 / 1099 income excluding the exercise, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

carryforwardCredit.description: Existing federal AMT credit from prior years, USD.

cashReturnRate.description: Annual after-tax return on idle cash as a decimal, used to time-value AMT premiums. Optional; defaults to 0.04 when omitted.

grantDate.description: ISO 8601 grant date (YYYY-MM-DD). Drives the 10-year expiration and 2-year qualifying-disposition gate.

hasLeftCompany.description: True if the user has departed the company. When true and the 90-day post-termination window is open, the result includes a partial-exercise recommendation.

terminationDate.description: Termination date (YYYY-MM-DD) if departed; pass null otherwise. When set, opens the 90-day post-termination exercise window.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__NSO_CALCULATE
description: Computes the after-tax payout on a non-qualified stock option (NSO) exercise: federal, state, FICA (Social Security + Medicare + Additional Medicare) on the bargain element, then compares selling at exercise versus holding for long-term capital gains across the chosen horizon. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Use this for NSO grants; for ISOs use OPTIONSAHOY__AMT_ISO_OPTIMIZE, for RSUs use OPTIONSAHOY__RSU_SELL_VS_HOLD. Every required field must come from the user or be derivable from an optional ticker; never invent a value.

currentPrice.description: Current fair market value per share at exercise, USD.

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual W-2 / 1099 income excluding the exercise, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

stillEmployed.description: FICA (Social Security + Medicare) applies only when true.

holdYears.description: Hold horizon in years. Sub-1-year is short-term and out of scope.

expectedSalePrice.description: Expected sale price per share at horizon, USD. Required unless ticker resolves it from currentPrice x (1 + trailing CAGR)^holdYears.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma) as a decimal. Either this or haircut is required; if both supplied, haircut wins.

haircut.description: Volatility-drag haircut on expectedSalePrice. Either this or volatility is required; if both supplied, this wins.

expectedMarketReturn.description: Per-year median market return rate (vol-drag pre-applied). Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for holdYears if omitted.

ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol. When set, resolves expectedSalePrice and/or volatility from cached tables.

holdFunding.description: How the strike cost and exercise tax are funded.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__RSU_SELL_VS_HOLD
description: Compares the after-tax payout from selling restricted stock unit (RSU) shares at vest and reinvesting in the market versus holding the shares: includes the 12-month short-term-vs-long-term capital-gains cliff, state tax, FICA, and the optional growth assumption. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Use this for RSUs at vest; for ISOs use OPTIONSAHOY__AMT_ISO_OPTIMIZE, for NSOs use OPTIONSAHOY__NSO_CALCULATE. Every required field must come from the user or be derivable from an optional ticker; never invent a value.

body.description: RSU sell-at-vest vs hold request body.

currentPrice.description: Fair market value per share at vest, USD.

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual W-2 / 1099 income excluding the vest, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

holdYears.description: Hold horizon in years (0.25-5). At or above 1, appreciation gets long-term capital gains treatment.

expectedSalePrice.description: Projected sale price per share at end of holdYears, USD. Required unless ticker resolves it from currentPrice x (1 + trailing CAGR)^holdYears.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma) as a decimal. Either this or haircut is required; if both supplied, haircut wins.

haircut.description: Volatility-drag haircut on expectedSalePrice. Either this or volatility is required; if both supplied, this wins.

expectedMarketReturn.description: Per-year reinvestment rate. Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for holdYears if omitted.

ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol. When set, resolves expectedSalePrice and/or volatility from cached tables.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__CONCENTRATION_ANALYZE
description: Quantifies single-stock concentration risk: drawdown exposure at 30/50/70% scenarios, sell-down plans over 1/2/3 years with multi-year tax math, the tax saved by waiting for long-term treatment, and a Black-Scholes hedging cost. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Every required field must come from the user or be derivable from an optional ticker; never invent a value. totalAssets is user-supplied and never inferred.

positionValue.description: Current value of the concentrated position, USD.

costBasis.description: Cost basis of the position, USD.

sector.description: Sector of the concentrated stock, used for volatility/drawdown context and hedge pricing.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual ordinary income, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

totalAssets.description: Total investable portfolio in dollars (concentrated position + everything else). User-supplied; never inferred.

expectedPositionReturn.description: Annual return on the concentrated stock as a decimal. Required unless ticker resolves it from trailing CAGR.

expectedMarketReturn.description: Annual return on diversified holdings + reinvested proceeds. Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for the 3-year horizon if omitted.

ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol. When set, resolves expectedPositionReturn and/or volatility from cached tables.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma) as a decimal. Used for the Black-Scholes hedging path and, when volatilityDrag is omitted, to derive price drag. Either this or volatilityDrag is required for drag.

volatilityDrag.description: Multiplicative haircut on the 3-year stock-price path. Either this or volatility is required for drag; if both supplied, this wins.

hedgeChoice.description: Optional explicit hedge to price instead of the default 1-year 30%-OTM put.

protectionLevel.description: Drawdown the hedge protects against, as a fraction (0.20 = 20% below current).

upsideCapPct.description: For a collar, the upside cap as a fraction above current.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__PROTECTIVE_PUT_PRICE
description: Prices three hedge structures on a single-stock position using Black-Scholes: a protective put, a zero-cost collar, and a put spread. Reports annual cost, maximum loss, upside cap, bad-year coverage, a payoff table, and a recommended structure. Every required field must come from the user; never invent a value.

body.description: Protective put, zero-cost collar, and put spread pricing request body.

positionValue.description: Current value of the position to hedge, USD.

sector.description: Sector of the underlying, used for default volatility and drift.

protectionLevel.description: Drawdown the put protects against, as a fraction (0.20 = 20% below current).

volatility.description: Annualized implied volatility (sigma) as a decimal. Defaults to a sector-typical implied vol when omitted.

expectedReturn.description: Override the sector long-run drift (mu) for probability metrics; does not affect premium math.

spreadRiskLevel.description: Put spread floor breach risk: probability the stock ends below the spread's short strike (presets 0.20 / 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.01, i.e. 1 in 5 / 10 / 20 / 100; off-preset snaps to the nearest). Affects only the putSpread block. Default 0.10.

ticker.description: Covered public ticker to source implied volatility from (for example "NVDA").

name: OPTIONSAHOY__QSBS_CHECK
description: Evaluates Section 1202 Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) against the six statutory tests, returning the verdict, exclusion percentage, federal tax saved, per-test status, and state conformity under the OBBBA 2026 tiered exclusion rules. Every required field must come from the user; for enum fields that accept "unsure", pass "unsure" when the user does not know rather than guessing.

entityType.description: Issuing entity type. Only a United States C corporation can issue QSBS.

acquisitionMethod.description: How the stock was acquired. Pass "unsure" if unknown.

assetCategory.description: Gross assets of the issuer at issuance. Pass "unsure" if unknown.

industry.description: Issuer industry. Certain service industries are excluded from QSBS. Pass "unsure" if unknown.

activeBusiness.description: Whether the issuer met the active-business requirement. Pass "unsure" if unknown.

adjustedBasis.description: Adjusted basis in the stock, USD.

expectedGain.description: Expected capital gain on sale, USD.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual ordinary income, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__EQUITY_FUNDING_PLAN
description: Returns the optimal multi-year share-sale schedule to fund a cash goal (e.g. selling equity to buy a house) by a target date. Produces four named plans on the risk/wealth frontier (Lock-in-now / Balanced / Hold-for-growth / Recommended) plus the full hybrid frontier, with bracket-aware tax math and lognormal shortfall probability. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Provide either stacks (multi-stack) or legacy lots + currentPrice (single-stack). Every required field must come from the user; never invent a value.

body.description: Equity-funding plan request body. Provide either stacks (preferred, multi-stack) OR legacy lots + currentPrice (single-stack).

targetAfterTax.description: Net after-tax cash goal to reach, USD.

targetDate.description: ISO 8601 date by which the cash is needed (YYYY-MM-DD).

stacks.description: Multi-stack input (preferred). Each stack is one ticker with its lots.

ticker.description: Optional ticker label. When set without expectedAnnualGrowth, the server resolves growth from the trailing-CAGR table.

currentPrice.description: Current share price for this stack, USD.

expectedAnnualGrowth.description: Expected annual growth as a decimal.

volatility.description: Per-stack annualized sigma. Overrides defaultVolatility for this stack.

shares.description: Number of shares in this lot.

vestDate.description: Optional future vest date for unvested RSU tranches; excluded from sales before this date.

lots.description: Legacy single-stack input. Pair with top-level currentPrice.

shares.description: Number of shares in this lot.

currentPrice.description: Legacy single-stack current share price, USD.

expectedAnnualGrowth.description: Legacy single-stack annual growth as a decimal.

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual ordinary income, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

cashInterestRate.description: Annualized pre-tax yield on cash held between each sale and the target date. Server compounds at the after-tax marginal rate. Defaults to 0.

riskToleranceShortfall.description: Max acceptable probability that realized cash lands below target under the lognormal price model. The recommended plan is the wealth-maximal plan at or below this. Default 0.10.

defaultVolatility.description: Annualized sigma used for stacks that omit their own volatility. Default 0.30.

name: OPTIONSAHOY__RSU_LOT_OPTIMIZE
description: Which vested RSU lots to sell, and when, to divest a target share fraction at the lowest tax: specific-lot identification, long-term deferral, and multi-year bracket spreading versus a first-in-first-out (FIFO) sell order. Returns the year-by-year sell schedule, total tax (federal LTCG plus NIIT plus state), and the saving versus a FIFO sell order on the same schedule. Relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Every required field must come from the user; never invent a value.

body.description: RSU lot-order divest plan request body. Vested RSU lots plus a divest fraction; the server chooses which lots to sell on which dates to divest the target share count at the lowest tax.

lots.description: Vested RSU lots you still hold, one per vest tranche.

shares.description: Shares still held from this vest. Fractional allowed.

costBasisPerShare.description: Per-share cost basis, USD (the share price on vest day).

currentPrice.description: Current share price, USD. Every sale is priced at this value (flat-price assumption).

divestFraction.description: Fraction of total shares to divest, as a decimal (0.5 = sell half). Range 0.10 to 1.0.

horizonYears.description: Tax years the plan may span: 1 (sell all now), 2, or 3.

ordinaryIncome.description: Total household ordinary income for the year, USD, taxable income after deductions (no standard or itemized deduction is applied). Sets the LTCG bracket floor, short-term rate, and NIIT threshold.

stateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).
